My New Channel Instantly Failed
Alright, hear me out.

So I had a channel where I made game theory videos on Five Nights at Freddy's. It was going great, 1.4k subscribers in a matter of months. I did a good mix of shorts and long forms with my long forms typically getting around 500-1k views, and my shorts getting anywhere from 10k-50k views per short. However, due to certain reasons I decided I would stop posting FNAF theories on that channel and instead create a brand new channel with a new name, but still continue to post FNAF theories. The editing style would be the same, music would be the same, basically, I just picked up where I left off on a brand new channel.

However, here's where it started to go downhill. Yesterday I posted my first video, it was a short. I wanted to start with shorts just to test things out a little before going full on long forms. But, I posted the first theory short yesterday morning, it's now at 8 views. I made another video today, 3 views so far.

The heck!?

I've started new channels multiple times before, some for shorts, others for long forms, each in a different niche. Usually, a bad short on a new channel will at least get 500-1k views. This new channel though is doing terrible.

Now, I'm not the most insane editor on the planet, but I am pretty good (not trying to brag at all). I understand how to make smooth flowing videos, use music and sound effects properly, keep people interested the whole time. The same goes for script writing. Basically, everything about my videos is done pretty well, I've had success on multiple other channels before just by using my knowledge of the algorithm, script writing, and editing. This however has me without any answers, I was really hoping this channel would take off like my old one, or at least show signs that with consistency it would get up there.

Can anyone help me? I'm really lost with what to do. Should I just keep posting or is something seriously wrong?
